acceptance_criteria.description: Stuck event ingestion: kernel ingests a valid stuck event with resolution and produces a Card with awaiting_response phase, correct aggregate state, and stored Stuck message.
mandatory_checks: aggregate has one revision with Card
messages table has one stuck row
replay of same Stuck returns identical result
replay of Stuck with different payload raises KernelRefusalError

acceptance_criteria.description: Start response: responding 'start' to a valid Card transitions interaction to observing phase with an observation deadline and accepted response record.
mandatory_checks: replay of same response returns identical result
second response with different id but same card raises KernelRefusalError

acceptance_criteria.description: Shrink response: responding 'shrink' to a valid Card transitions interaction back to preparing with a follow-up Card at next revision.
mandatory_checks: next Card is prepared and published
card_index has new entry for next revision

acceptance_criteria.description: Blocked response: responding 'blocked' to a valid Card transitions interaction back to preparing with a blocked follow-up Card.
mandatory_checks: next Card has blocked followup context
card_index has new entry for next revision

acceptance_criteria.description: Defer response: responding 'defer' to a valid Card completes the interaction with terminal_status completed.
mandatory_checks: replay of same defer returns identical result

acceptance_criteria.description: Dismiss response: responding 'dismiss' to a valid Card completes the interaction with terminal_status completed.
Card expiry: when the Card's expires_at_epoch is reached, the kernel refuses new responses and transitions the interaction to expired/card_not_posted_before_expiry.
mandatory_checks: respond after Card expiry raises KernelRefusalError
reopened database still shows expired state

acceptance_criteria.description: Observation completion: when observation_due_at_epoch is reached while in observing phase, reconcile advances to completed.
mandatory_checks: reconcile transitions observing to terminal completed

acceptance_criteria.description: Revision ceiling: after max_card_revisions shrink/blocked responses, the next shrink/blocked response completes the interaction with completed/shrink_limit_reached or completed/blocked_unresolved.
mandatory_checks: final shrink response returns terminal_status completed/shrink_limit_reached

acceptance_criteria.description: Idempotent Stuck replay: re-ingesting an identical Stuck event returns the original result with replay flag true.
mandatory_checks: second ingest with identical payload returns replay=True
no duplicate rows in any table

acceptance_criteria.description: Idempotent Response replay: re-responding with an identical Response returns the original result with replay flag true.
mandatory_checks: second respond with identical payload returns replay=True

acceptance_criteria.description: Task change supersession: when a response arrives with a different task revision than the one used for the original Stuck, the response is superseded.
mandatory_checks: response with different task revision returns status superseded

acceptance_criteria.description: check_database integrity: check_database returns status ok with correct counts when database is valid.
show: show returns expected fields for an interaction, sensitive data only when include_sensitive=True.
list_active: list_active returns only non-terminal interactions with correct fields.
mandatory_checks: each entry has event_id, interaction_id, phase, state_version, needs_reconciliation

acceptance_criteria.description: reconcile: reconcile advances all overdue non-terminal interactions, returning counts of changed/expired/completed.
Restart resilience: closing and reopening the database preserves all persisted state including aggregate, messages, and Card index.
mandatory_checks: show returns the same phase and terminal_status

acceptance_criteria.description: Schema structural validation: initialize and check_database verify exact three-table structure, column sets, indices, and foreign keys.
mandatory_checks: exact FK: messages.event_id -> interactions.event_id, card_index.event_id -> interactions.event_id

acceptance_criteria.description: Permission enforcement: store rejects directories not 0700, DB files not 0600, and files owned by a different uid.
Canonical encoding: all new writes use compact canonical JSON; non-canonical stored JSON is rejected by check_database.
mandatory_checks: non-canonical aggregate (indented) raises KernelCorruptionError on check_database
non-canonical result raises KernelCorruptionError on check_database

acceptance_criteria.description: Strict JSON decoding: NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, and duplicate object keys are rejected at decode time.
mandatory_checks: duplicate keys in payload_json raises KernelCorruptionError
valid JSON with different whitespace is still accepted by strict reader

acceptance_criteria.description: Reducer reconstruction gate: check_database reconstructs the expected aggregate from stored messages and verifies it matches the stored aggregate.
mandatory_checks: reconstructed aggregate matches stored aggregate for valid interactions

acceptance_criteria.description: Cross-row consistency: all rows for an interaction share the same event_id, interaction_id matches between SQL and aggregate, message reservations correspond to actual messages.
Corrupt aggregate: malformed, missing-keys, or invalid-typed aggregate_json raises KernelCorruptionError.
mandatory_checks: aggregate with missing required key raises KernelCorruptionError
aggregate with extra unknown key raises KernelCorruptionError
aggregate with invalid phase raises KernelCorruptionError
aggregate with wrong type for revision raises KernelCorruptionError

acceptance_criteria.description: Corrupt message payload: payload_json that fails validation or has mismatched hash raises KernelCorruptionError.
mandatory_checks: stuck payload with missing event_id raises KernelCorruptionError
response payload with invalid schema_version raises KernelCorruptionError

acceptance_criteria.description: Corrupt Card index: Card index rows that don't match the aggregate's revisions raise KernelCorruptionError.
mandatory_checks: card_index missing for a published Card raises KernelCorruptionError
card_index with wrong event_id raises KernelCorruptionError
card_index with wrong revision number raises KernelCorruptionError

acceptance_criteria.description: Replay bundle validation: validate_replay_bundle verifies exact result shape and cross-row consistency for Stuck and Response messages.
mandatory_checks: stuck replay verifies exact key set and IDs
start response replay verifies phase and observation deadline
shrink response replay verifies next_card contents
superseded response replay verifies requested_action and status

acceptance_criteria.description: Atomicity: partial writes during ingest_stuck or respond roll back completely on failure.
mandatory_checks: ingest_stuck failure leaves no rows in any table
respond failure leaves all tables unchanged from pre-response state

acceptance_criteria.description: WAL rejection: store rejects WAL journal mode and normalizes to delete on initialize.
mandatory_checks: WAL-mode DB raises KernelStorageError on write

deferred.description: Receipt validation: Receipt objects are provisional, not part of the frozen five-schema set. Acceptance criteria for Receipt delivery evidence and confirmation are deferred to Milestone 3.
Milestone 3 Tasker integration: Tasker and laptop clock synchronization with the 300-second allowance is deferred to Milestone 3.
